subject: general
question: The World Boxing Championships 2025, featuring both men’s and women’s events together for the first time, will be held in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Liverpool.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Indian boxers will compete in the World Boxing Championships starting in Liverpool, United Kingdom.**
 
• **This is the first edition of the Championships to be staged under the new governing body – World Boxing – and will feature men’s and women’s events together.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Venue: Liverpool, United Kingdom.**
 
• **For the first time, both men’s and women’s events are being held together.**
 
• **India had a successful run in 2023: women won four golds in New Delhi; men won three bronzes in Tashkent.**
 
• **Star boxers Nikhat Zareen (51kg), Lovlina Borgohain (75kg), and veteran Pooja Rani will lead the women’s squad.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Nikhat Zareen**__

 __
 
• Two-time world champion.
 
• Won earlier titles in 52kg and 50kg categories; now competing in 51kg.
 
 
 
• **Lovlina Borgohain**__
 __
 
• Tokyo Olympic bronze medallist and three-time Worlds medallist.
 
• Will defend her crown in the 75kg weight class.
 
 
 
• **Indian Men’s Squad**__
 __
 
• Led by Sumit Kundu (returning after injury).
 
• Includes 2021 World Youth champion Sachin Siwach and Harsh Choudhary (both with Worlds experience).
 
• Debutants: Jadumani Singh Mandengbam, Hitesh Gulia, Abhinash Jamwal.
 
 
 
• **Governing Body**__
 
 
• The event is being conducted under the aegis of “World Boxing”.
